next.reason: 1985 requires qualification of every non-unique referenced name 'except in the case of redefinition'. §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 keeps 'uniqueness shall be established through a sequence of qualifiers'. But §2023:8.4.2.2.1 adds exemptions, among them 'The name is a data-name referenced in a data description entry clause whose subject is subordinate to the same group item as that data-name', with implicit qualifiers. So an unqualified non-unique OCCURS DEPENDING ON object that 1985 refused is accepted in 2023 (looser), and the VARYING and type-declaration exemptions cover new features. Special-register qualification is carried by 8.4.2.2.3 SR8 to SR10. The cross-program paragraph/section bar is the uncataloged §2023:8.4.6.1 ('may be referenced only by statements in the source element in which the user-defined word is declared').
